# stb_truetype

`stb_truetype.h` v1.26 from https://github.com/nothings/stb, unmodified. Dual licensed MIT / public domain (the license
text is at the end of the header). Used by the sceLibFont HLE to rasterize free fonts.

`stb_image.h` v2.30 and `stb_image_write.h` v1.16 from the same repository (commit
`003501f6d7a8668ce8b6d875e34dd97ad0d5d5b5`), unmodified, same licenses: texture pack PNG images (PNG only) and the
texture dumps pack makers start from.
